question_text: Produce a security-attention report for 2025-12-08 (UTC) at the AI Hardware Summit. Specifically highlight (1) the gate that handles the largest volume of person traffic, (2) the gate with the most car traffic, and (3) the public area with the highest crowd density spikes. Quantify each with approximate numbers and times.

rubric: Gate_MainEntrance handles the largest person traffic volume
Gate_ParkingLot handles the most car traffic
